headline: México y China abren una "nueva era" comercial tras encuentro entre Sheinbaum y Xi: CCE
summary: Mexico and China are opening a new era of commercial relations after President Claudia Sheinbaum met Xi Jinping at the APEC summit, the Mexican Business Coordinating Council said.
why: China is one of Mexico's largest trading partners, and changes in trade ties affect manufacturing supply chains and tariff exposure for North American firms.
